name: Real Signal Multiplexer
description: The real signal multiplexer function code selects a real signal from a group of inputs, and provides this signal as the block output. Any number of real signal multiplexer blocks can be joined to multiplex any number of signals. Each block contains ten real inputs. The first block in the link list is the group master. The master accepts a select input and searches the other blocks in the link list to find the selected input. The ten values in the master block are zero through nine. The range of parameters associated with the next block in the link list is ten through 19, and so on. If several blocks are in series, the output always comes from the first block in the series. The outputs of the rest of the blocks in the series are unused.
